title: Advanced: explicit storage mappings
guidance: Host roots belong to the daemon host; execution roots belong to the selected Python execution environment. Mapping only rewrites paths lexically: it does not upload files, mount storage, resolve symlinks or verify access. Configure storage and site policy outside this form.
interpreter: The interpreter path is an execution-realm path, not a host path to remap. Enter only mappings you explicitly configured; dataset and other draft paths are never changed by this editor.
local: The local backend refuses nonempty storage mappings. Remove mappings or explicitly select your intended non-local backend; switching backends does not clear this draft.
empty: No mapping configured. Existing host-path behavior is unchanged.
limit: Up to 32 explicit mappings. Each root is limited to 8192 characters.
rootError: Enter an absolute root without parent traversal, control characters or invalid path syntax (8192 characters maximum).
rowError: Host and execution roots must use the same path platform.
mapError: Use no more than 32 mappings with unique host roots.
